content.query:
Alter view dw.depagg_test
as 
Select dc.customersk, dc.customerid, dc.globalcif, mtd.businessdatesk, 
        mtd.branchsk, mtd.banksk, mtd.accountid, mtd.accountsk, mtd.averagedailbalanceamountmtdprorated , mtd.sourcesystemcode from dw.dimcustomer as dc
left join dw.dimcustomeraccount as dca
    on dca.customersk = dc.customersk
inner join dw.factaveragedailybalanceMTD as mtd
    on mtd.accountsk = dca.accountsk
